--------------------------------------
Target song: "The Things That I Used to Do"

Find every singer who (a) has EVER won a Grammy Award or a Brit Award, AND (b) released at least one song in the same calendar year as "The Things That I Used to Do". For each matching singer state their birthplace and the population of that birthplace.

Note: The award-winning recording and the co-year song are typically different works. Condition (b) does not require an award-winning song - any song released by that singer in that year qualifies.
Do not invent or estimate any fact.

Reasoning approach: Apply all conditions simultaneously in a single pass.

Output format
-------------
Start your answer with the line:
  ANSWER:
On the very next line write:
  Release year: [YYYY]
Then list one line per matching singer in this exact format:
  [Singer Name] | [Birthplace] | [Population]
Where:
  Singer Name    = the singer's full name in English
  Birthplace     = the city or place of birth in English (write "unknown" if not found)
  Population     = the population of that place as a number (write "unknown" if not found)
If no singers match the criteria, write:
  No matching singers found.
Do not include any other text after the ANSWER: section.
Do not invent or estimate facts. Omit any singer you cannot verify.

ANSWER:
